name: Itsuwari no Seibo ~Gibo ni Uwaki Genba o Mokugekisareta Ore wa, Donna Youkyuu ni mo Shitagau Inu to Natta~
original_name: 偽りの聖母 ～義母に浮気現場を目撃された俺は、どんな要求にも従う犬となった～
source:
With the meeting over and the date set for the ceremony. On a whim, I ended up spending the night with my ex-girlfriend. I had no idea that my fiancée's mother would witness it. 

"Don't worry about it, I won't tell anyone, it's normal for young people to play with fire♪"

She's not only forgiving, but she's a mother-in-law who takes my feelings into consideration.... Isn't she truly a saintly mother? 

"I'd like to thank you for your kindness. I'll do anything for my mother-in-law!"

"If that's the case, lick my pussy, now♪"

There, with her legs open and a twisted smile on her face, was my mother-in-law looking down at me.

会议结束后，仪式日期也已确定。一时兴起，我最终和我的前女友一起过夜。我不知道我未婚妻的母亲会见证这一切。

“你放心，我不会告诉任何人，年轻人玩火很正常♪”

她不仅是一个宽容的人，还是一个会照顾我感受的婆婆……她不是一个真正的圣女母亲吗？

“谢谢你的好意，为了婆婆，我愿意做任何事！”

“既然这样，那就舔我的小穴吧♪”

我的婆婆张开双腿，脸上挂着扭曲的微笑，低头看着我。
